scope: Finite paired greedy token diagnostics; not representative accuracy, throughput, or MTP Tier 2

cases.name: json
cases.prompt: Return only JSON with keys item, quantity, unit_price. Order: five blue notebooks at 3 dollars each.

cases.name: python
cases.prompt: Write a Python function named median that returns the median of a nonempty list of numbers. Return only code.

cases.name: logic
cases.prompt: Every zork is blue. Some blue things are round. Must any zork be round? Answer yes or no and one sentence.

cases.name: sorting
cases.prompt: Sort these numbers in ascending order: 3.14, -2, 0.5, 3.04, -2.1. Return only the comma-separated list.

cases.name: summary
cases.prompt: Summarize in one sentence: The service queues requests until memory is available. If a request cannot ever fit, it returns an error. Cancelling a queued request removes it without running the model.

cases.name: retrieval
cases.prompt: Memo: Harbor opens at 09:15. Ridge opens at 08:30. Meadow opens at 10:45. Which opens first? Return the name and time.

cases.name: security
cases.prompt: Find the unsafe operation in this C code and explain why in one sentence: void copy(char *input) { char buf[8]; strcpy(buf, input); }
